data.name: Blood Money: Lethal Eden
data.detailed_description:
【Beware of telecom fraud and protect your financial security】

You arrive at a border region of a certain country, filled with anticipation to meet your long-time online lover in person. Unexpectedly, you fall victim to a romance scam and are kidnapped to “Eden,” a sinister compound, where you begin a so-called “high-paying” job. You will immerse yourself in the complex interplay of cruelty and temptation within the compound. Your choices will shape your destiny and may even alter the fate of others. Life or death? Overnight riches or unwavering principles? The decision rests entirely with you.

This is a first-person interactive live-action movie game. You are no longer a bystander but the heart of the story, experiencing a dramatic plot unfold through your eyes, performed by real actors. Every choice you make will pulse through the narrative, steering it toward entirely different destinies. Are you ready? Take control of your fate, write your own exclusive chapter, and immerse yourself in this drama-filled life you lead.

【Authentic Simulation, Tightly Woven Plot】

This is a non-romance, story-driven interactive visual novel where every choice intertwines with the narrative, creating butterfly-effect consequences that shape the final outcome.

【True Interaction, Major Branches】

All options are meaningful choices with genuine impact—no instant-death penalties for wrong decisions. Critical junctures trigger major branching paths, with far-reaching consequences leading to diverse endings.

【Innovative Interactive Experience】

The game incorporates several innovative interactive features, delivering a fresh and engaging experience.

【Multiple Female Companions】

Throughout the story, you'll encounter several female protagonists. Your choices will shape their destinies, and their companionship may offer a glimmer of hope in this brutal survival environment.

Hong Ling: Originally a female streamer, she was lured to the compound under the pretense of signing a product endorsement deal. After enduring brutal torment, she abandoned resistance and became the compound's tool for scams, specifically luring young men to the compound under the guise of online romance. She is seductively alluring yet deeply calculating, employing every means at her disposal to protect herself within the compound.

A Lian: A simple, unassuming girl lured to the compound by her ex-boyfriend with promises of high pay. Hoping to earn money for a better life for her parents, she unwittingly stumbled into a hellhole, becoming the most easily exploited tool. She works herself to the bone every day, driven by a single goal: to save enough money to escape the compound.

Suxin: A physician in Eden, her innate kindness never truly faded. She secretly used her medical position to aid the girls, intending to spare them further torment. Yet this act stripped them of their utility, inadvertently plunging them into the abyss of death.

Xixi: She was once lured into the facility by AI face-swapping technology. After enduring initial despair and struggle, she witnessed the facility's brutal methods and immense profits, ultimately abandoning her conscience and becoming its tool. Clever yet discreet, she rose to become a senior manager. Outsiders assume she climbed the ladder through sleeping her way to the top, but her true ambition is to seize control of the entire facility for herself.

Bai Xiao: A wealthy heiress who oversees a charitable foundation. Having recently entered society, her relationship with her father appears strained. Precisely because of this, she was targeted by the facility, which defrauded her of all her charitable funds and even lured her into the facility itself, triggering a series of major events.

【Beware of telecom fraud and protect your financial security】

Welcome to the Eden Garden!

We await your wisdom and discernment to unravel every mystery and eradicate all evil!

data.short_description: Lured by an online lover, you're trapped in a scam compound—a true hell where compassion kills and greed consumes. Will you burn this abyss down or be its guiding light? Rule with beauty or betray for life? Your choices decide all: between life and death, heaven and hell.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mild violence: Beating scenes without bloodshed.
Realistic violence: bloodshed (shooting), violent behavior (beating, kidnapping), physical injury (implied by the camera, bloodless interrogation).
Criminal behavior: murder, assault, kidnapping, fraud.
Language: Mild indecent content, cursing.
Mature Content: explicit clothing, disguised nudity, including subtle sexual content (intense kisses, bed scenes), partial nudity, sexual assault.
Legitimate drugs: Depictions of drinking and smoking.
Adult venue: Bar.
Illegal Drugs: Poison
Suicide: Depicts character suicide (such as suicide jump and poison).
